_: Framing per shot (MOTION-SYSTEM.md §1, revised 11 Sep for v8.3). Every take is the one locked-off FRONT framing (Ava's face at 1950,900 of 3840×2160, head top 600, shoulders 1410) and every proxy is now that whole frame scaled to 1920×1080 — the 1.5× SIDE and 1.7× CLOSE windows are kept in `windows` but no shot uses them: Faisal's ruling is that the clip stays as shot unless an overlay is up. `ava` is the side the virtual camera sends her to while a panel is on screen (L = her face 30% in from the left edge, the panel in the right column; R the mirror; C never pushed), which build.mjs does with a 1.42× push on the footage alone — the overlays sit outside the camera. angles.mjs turns the angle into the ffmpeg crop and her face position on the proxy.
